residual.wall: The 1000-point system exists as three locked fields. Locomotion and viscosity ignore two of them. Shape-snap and regional physics were designed here and never mastered.

question: What still exists of the 512/360/672/1000 lock, what does each field actually write, and what must be mastered before any more gait cuts?
coordinateSpaces: Polar body UV. Contour: 512 samples, θ from −π/2, content px. Lattice: 15 rings × 24 sectors = 360 nodes, 672 triangles; vertex.radial ∈ [0,1] samples the contour. Relief/scaffold: 25 rings × 40 sectors = 1000, Float32 z, ring 24 is the rim. AdaptiveReliefInstrument uses a different golden-spiral 1000 — not the painter grid.
physicalLaw: Topology lock: 512 contour / 360 lattice / 672 tris / 1000 relief. Counts never change. Shape change is an embedding, not a remesh.
Interior → Pressure → Surface (GASPER-008/009). The 1000-field is pressure. The 512 is the surface it may push. Coupling is scaffoldContourZ on ring 24. Neutral rim is exact 0.
One pearl. The 360 lattice is mass inside the 512, not a second hull. meshOffsets are sculpt on the lattice, then appliedMeshWarp back onto the contour.
Regional isolation is a material field on the locked UV (τ, E, pressure per sample). It is not a new writer and not a W-rig.
Arbitrary shape (blowfish, remote) = a target 512-embedding. The lattice follows the contour. Relief stays in UV. No fourth topology.
artisticLaw: Goosebumps are DETAIL_TOPOLOGY vector material, not tiled quads (D-0086) and not a face painter.
Blowfish is whole-mass pressure, then rim. Not _formK ±2.5%.
A TV remote is still Gasper: 512 samples satisfy a new silhouette; face/membrane stay seq18 unless the embodiment drops the face (singularity).
Do not merge 512, 360, and 1000. Coupled, not collapsed.
invariants: Do not add a 4000-point tier (VEC-201 retired it).
Do not remesh for a target shape.
Do not drive gait or KV from AdaptiveReliefInstrument's golden spiral — painter is polar 25×40.
Do not delete the 512 contour walk. Master the lock; do not replace it with shoes.
Investigate only this receipt. No gait recut.
failureModes: Calling the 360 lattice 'the 1000 mesh' — 360 is mass, 1000 is pressure.
Plant-gated τ on contour only: interior 1000 stays one material. Run looks clay inside a stiff W.
Named FORM_PROFILES only (presence, wispwalker, comet, singularity, dormant-orbit, low-orbit, halo). No target-curve fit. Remote cannot be assumed.
Two 1000 evaluators: AdaptiveReliefInstrument (TS, face regions, tests) vs SidekickReliefFields.evaluateRelief (live paint). Twin.
GasperContourSolver.ts hull twin. Probes can lie.
scaffoldCoupling default 0.5 but rim 0 at calm — inside-out looks dead until a preset.
uncertainty: Whether __GASPER_SCAFFOLD_Z__ is published every frame from the live relief pipe or only when a relief preset is on. Code comments both.
meshOffsets persistence across takes — sculpt memory vs snap.
Morphology domain GSAP tracks: catalogued, mostly not the live writer.
tests: Neutral relief: rim ring all 0. scaffoldContourZ === 0.
Goose preset: vector paths, no 25×40 tiled quads.
No live path imports AdaptiveReliefInstrument into all-script-3.js.
FORM_PROFILES has no remote/blowfish. Shape-snap API does not exist yet.
visualConsequences: Today: a pearl with a painted skin and a 512 outline. Regions are gauss recipes, not a mastered field.
Mastered: goose reads as skin, puff reads as pressure, a remote is the same being in a new embedding.
implementation: Pivot: master the lock before L1/L2 legs.
Name three organs on the atlas: Contour 512 · Lattice 360 · Relief 1000.
Unify the 1000: painter polar 25×40 is the live field. Port AdaptiveReliefInstrument regions onto that grid or retire the golden-spiral twin.
Regional physics: Float32Array[1000] τ (or E) sampled by contour the way scaffoldContourZ already samples z. Plant gate becomes a region, not a special case.
Shape-snap (later): target polyline → 512 embedding, lattice follows, relief UV held. Blowfish is a radial pressure preset on the 1000. Remote is a target embedding.
Do not recut gait, run-in-place, or N349 this receipt.

Contour, lattice, relief, face, skin are separate domains. A contour-only morph is invalid as complete morph.
